purpose: Defines how a new civilization's starting scientific history is seeded without assigning it a fixed future technology tree. Species/start definitions compose historical research fragments, biology/applicability traits, institutions, pressures, evidence, capabilities, and competence into a valid initial Adaptive Research state.

profile_shape.starting_node_states: map node_id -> maturity state plus optional archive resolution
profile_shape.starting_capabilities: capability ids with scope/context where required
profile_shape.starting_research_institutions: institution archetype ids and aggregate counts/effective capacity
profile_shape.starting_pressure_state: only recognized/relevant pressure seeds; normal unknown future pressure is not pre-created
profile_shape.starting_evidence: only evidence the civilization could legitimately possess at campaign start
profile_shape.starting_tacit_assets: only historically justified strategically meaningful knowledge assets

composition_rules.field_competence_combination: take strongest justified seed per component then apply explicit composition cap; never sum percentages

comparable_era_rule.meaning: Playable starts can be broadly comparable early-spacefaring/pre-FTL civilizations without possessing identical technologies, infrastructure, or scientific competence.

species_start_workstream_supplies: biology/environment facts that map to public applicability traits
historical/infrastructure facts that select research-history fragments
starting home-system conditions that generate legitimate pressure/evidence
